open_points.subject: operation_element_conclusion on an element whose run has ended while its first approval remains requested
open_points.text: “an element waiting for its first approval has no NodeExecution yet, and the requested approval decides it” conflicts with “When its run ends, an approval that is still `requested` or unused can no longer be decided or used” and with “every other waiting element stops waiting without a record of its own”
open_points.question: When a run ends `refused` or `cancelled` while another element has a still-`requested` first approval and no NodeExecution, may `operation_element_conclusion` still return `waiting owner_approval`, is the operation never called for that ended run, or does it return another conclusion?
options: Restrict `operation_element_conclusion` to elements of runs that have not ended
Treat the void requested approval as no current wait and return `not reached`
Add a distinct terminal conclusion for an element abandoned when its run ended
open_points.default_guess: Restrict `operation_element_conclusion` to runs that have not ended; ended-run answers use the run's final status and trace without deriving outstanding element waits.
